run_experiment: run a HoloDiffusion training experiment using Hydra config and the Experiment class
run_Experiment_run: run the Experiment class run method to start model training with data loaders and optimizer
create_Experiment: create an Experiment instance with data source, model factory, optimizer factory, and training loop
dump_cfg: dump the experiment config to a YAML file in the experiment directory using OmegaConf
setup_logging: setup logging with hostname and timestamp format for experiment output
